description: This PHP script provides sample client functions for interacting with the TestLink XML-RPC API, including functions to create test projects, test plans, builds, and platforms. It demonstrates how to call remote API methods using the IXR_Client class and manages configuration for API requests.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class representing the XML-RPC client used to communicate with the TestLink server.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project on the TestLink server using the XML-RPC API.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan associated with a specified test project.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build associated with a specified test plan.

methods.name: createPlatform
methods.description: Creates multiple platform entries associated with a test project.
